## How I checked it
- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm test` pass

      (`npx promoreel sheet examples/generic/out/todo-promo.mp4 sheet.png`)
- [ ] Docs updated (`README.md`, `docs/spec.md` or `docs/flows.md`) if a field, step or command changed

## Safety
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, private footage or personal data in the diff
- [ ] The default path stays free and local (no new required API key or paid service)
